title: 摩根资管：主动ETF占美国市场13%资产，为何能吸引40%净流入？
speaker: Travis Spence

segments.en: in the connect program to get offshore investors to invest in China as well? Yeah, it's a great question. So I think initially yes it will be retail in China.
segments.zh: 在互联互通机制中让境外市场参与者也能参与内地市场？是的，这是个好问题。我认为初期确实会以内地散户为主。

segments.en: And again I think that's where Eric said we've got to be really good at active management.
segments.zh: 再次强调，正如Eric所说，我们必须擅长主动管理。

segments.en: And if you look at all of the active ETFs in the U.S., it's about 13% of the overall industry now, but driving about 40% of the net flows are going into active ETFs.
segments.zh: 看看美国所有的主动型ETF，目前约占整个行业的13%，但贡献了约40%的净流入。

segments.en: There's three main categories, core equities, so just like what we're doing in China, core fixed income.
segments.zh: 主要有三大类：核心权益资产，就像我们在内地市场做的，核心固定收益。

segments.en: And then as Eric said, the derivative based strategy. So almost 95% of the net flows, despite all of the craziness that's in the market and
segments.zh: 然后正如Eric所说，还有衍生品策略。所以尽管市场波动不断，近95%的净流入……

segments.en: new launches and levered and inverse, but 95% of the flows that are going into active ETFs are going into those core sectors.
segments.zh: 以及新发产品和杠杆反向产品，但95%流入主动型ETF的资金都进入了这些核心领域。

segments.en: So that I think is an exciting start for China.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这对内地市场来说是一个令人兴奋的开端。

segments.en: We would love to see active incorporated into the stock connect and the ETF connect.
segments.zh: 我们希望看到主动型产品被纳入权益资产通和ETF通。

segments.en: Not yet. But there's definitely a big amount of institutional demand for diversifying beyond what they
segments.zh: 目前还没有。但确实有大量机构需求，希望分散配置到他们……

segments.en: hold in China today. And so the insurance company is being able to now take advantage of that program, which for the first time is going to be an unencumbered because they don't have any limits in terms
segments.zh: 目前在内地市场持有的资产之外。因此保险公司现在能够利用该机制，这是首次无约束，因为他们没有限制……

segments.en: of the amount that they can grow to. But that gives the opportunity to start to diversify into the US market and global markets.
segments.zh: 在其可增长规模之内。但这提供了开始分散配置到美国市场和全球市场的机会。

segments.en: How do you compare the landscape for active ETFs across the world?
segments.zh: 您如何比较全球主动型ETF的格局？
